english.title: Speeding - exceed limit for type of vehicle ( not goods / passenger vehicle) - unmanned automatic equipment
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a mechanically propelled vehicle, being a **(..SPECIFY THE TYPE NOT BEING GOODS OR PASSENGER..), namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), at a speed exceeding **(..SPECIFY THE SPEED LIMIT FOR THAT TYPE OF VEHICLE..) miles per hour, the speed specified in Schedule 6 to the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 as being the maximum speed in relation to a vehicle of that class
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 86(1) and 89(1) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three to six penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

6 months
